due_when.clears_when: At least 3 executor-placed ETHUSD fills have closed and each fill's entry price is compared with the quote (bid/ask) read at placement, giving realized spread+slippage in bps against the 3 bps allowance; or the first executor fill's slippage already exceeds 10 bps and the manager is told.

observation.how_to_check: curl -sS 'https://ict-bot.duckdns.org/api/bot/prop/fills?account_id=breakout_1&limit=500' | python3 -c "import json,sys;print([(f['id'],f['symbol'],f['entry_price'],f['ticket_id']) for f in json.load(sys.stdin)['fills'] if f['symbol']=='ETHUSDT' and f['id']>53])"
observation.what: At least 3 executor-placed ETHUSD fills have closed and each fill's entry price is compared with the quote (bid/ask) read at placement, giving realized spread+slippage in bps against the 3 bps allowance; or the first executor fill's slippage already exceeds 10 bps and the manager is told.

what: ETH-prop executor-fill cost is unmeasured: no executor ETH fill exists (ETH live 2026-10-01). Measured so far: commission 8 bps RT, swap 3.3 bps/night (n=2), ETHUSD spread 1 tick = 0.037 bps (n=2 quiet-hour quotes); manual-fill entry deviation vs ticket mean +3.1 bps, mean abs 26 (human latency, not a cost estimate). The modelled 3 bps spread+slippage allowance is still an assumption for market orders.
